meeting.title: Bilingual local knowledge pilot review
meeting.timing_basis: Authored fixture timing, not measured from audio
meeting.note: Every person, organization, signal, competitor, and event in this short meeting is fictional and was written for this deterministic example.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: The pilot must keep every source excerpt and citation on the team's own machine.

knowledge_unit.summary: Keep source excerpts and citations on the team's own machine.

utterances.speaker: Chen
utterances.text: 在模拟反馈中，三个测试角色都要求中英混合资料一起搜索。

knowledge_unit.summary: 模拟反馈中的三个测试角色都要求搜索中英混合资料。

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: Let's add a bilingual evidence view beside each extracted item.

knowledge_unit.summary: Add a bilingual evidence view beside each extracted item.

utterances.speaker: Chen
utterances.text: 现在说话人标签在快速切换时会错位，需要人工修正。

knowledge_unit.summary: 快速切换说话人时标签会错位，需要人工修正。

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: We will ship upload-first because it is easier to audit than a live meeting bot.

knowledge_unit.summary: Ship an upload-first workflow because it is easier to audit than a live meeting bot.

utterances.speaker: Chen
utterances.text: 如果原文删除后只剩摘要，我们会失去可追溯性。

knowledge_unit.summary: 删除原文、只保留摘要会破坏可追溯性。

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: We still need to verify whether exports preserve Chinese punctuation.

knowledge_unit.summary: Verify whether exports preserve Chinese punctuation.

utterances.speaker: Chen
utterances.text: 如果大学实验室也需要同样的本地工作流，这可能是新机会。

knowledge_unit.summary: 需要本地工作流的大学实验室可能是新机会。

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: The fictional competitor exports summaries but omits the source passages.

knowledge_unit.summary: The fictional competitor's export omits source passages.

utterances.speaker: Chen
utterances.text: 我周五前整理三份虚构样本，并记录每项修改。

knowledge_unit.summary: 周五前整理三份虚构样本，并记录每项修改。
